## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Checks

- [ ] Tests were run, or the reason for skipping them is documented.
- [ ] Plugin changes were validated with `uv run python -m lab_mvp.plugins validate plugins/<package>`, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private local config, real customer data, proprietary data, or restricted technical data are included.
- [ ] Third-party code, data, images, or documentation have compatible license notices and attribution.
- [ ] Changes that could affect experiment safety, equipment control, safety limits, or recommendations were reviewed carefully.
